name: Screen time report
oneLiner: a generic phone turns in on slow 3D drift with a usage report on it: the daily total counts up, a week of stacked bars grows with today lit, the categories and most-used apps fill in; then the total lifts off the glass as a thick smoked slab and lands big beside the phone while the screen dims behind it
say: when the speaker confesses or quotes time spent on a phone ('I was on my phone six hours a day'): cut in on the sentence, the slab lands on the number. Set minutes to the real total, per to the line under it, and apps to what ate the time
